body:
## Problem

PR #2572  broke ClimaAtmos AMIP runs on GPU: compiling the fused cloud-fraction
broadcast kernel failed with `InvalidIRError` (`gpu_gc_pool_alloc`,
`jl_f__apply_iterate`), with the stacktrace pointing into `unrolled_filter`.

## Root cause

`unrolled_filter` (UnrolledUtilities v0.1.9) pushes items into a tuple
accumulator whose type changes at every step. For wide, complexly typed
broadcast expressions (fused EDMFX broadcasts), inference's recursion-widening
heuristics widen the accumulator, and the resulting dynamic dispatch and heap
allocation cannot be compiled for GPUs. The trigger is an inference budget,
which is why unit tests passed while AMIP failed.

## Changes

- Kernel-critical traversals build no tuples at all: `each_maskable_slice_index`
  and `equal_layout_shapes` compare each non-point layout against a reference
  layout, and `f_dim` reduces with a nothing-or-in
- Remaining kernel-reachable `unrolled_filter` calls (`layout_args`,
  `axes_at_colons`, `overlap_components`) use `unrolled_flatmap`, which maps
  each item to an empty or singleton tuple, avoidies.
- Scope errors are singleton exception types (`InvalidSubscopeError`,
  `NonOverlappingScopesError`) whose messages interpolate the scope types in
  `showerror` on the host only.
- Tests: `test/DataLayouts/opt_layout_args.jl` runs JET `@test_opt` over wide
  broadcasts and a fused multi-broadcast mixing `DataF` and `VIJFH` args (the
  AMIP failure shape); `test/aqua.jl` forbids `unrlit`
  in kernel-reachable directories. New Buildkite CPU and 1-GPU jobs run them.

## Companion change

UnrolledUtilities [PR 33](https://github.com/CliMA/UnrolledUtilities.jl/pull/33) fixes the root cause upstream by reimplementing `unrolled_filter`/`unrolled_split`/`unrolled_unique` via
`unrolled_flatmap`. This PR does not depend on it; all affected suites pass
against both v0.1.9 and the patched v0.1.10. Once v0.1.10 is registered, the
guardrail test can be dropped.
title: Fix GPU InvalidIRError from inference widening in broadcast argument traversal

body:
This PR adds a space that can supports multiple columns. This is needed to complete https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/issues/1723.

This PR have been tested with the `FluxnetSimulation`s in ClimaLand and it produces identical results with the current single column used for the `FluxnetSimulation`.

The remapping feature will not be done in this PR. For the purpose of calibration, this is not needed because the data is extracted from the ClimaCore fields rather than from the NetCDF files produced from the diagnostics.

Note that most of the code in this PR have been written with Claude.
title: Add space with multiple columns

body: This PR updates the CI to use a single `Pkg.develop` instead of multiple `Pkg.develop`. Each `Pkg.develop` results in resolving and updating the manifest so minimizing the number of times that `Pkg.develop` is called would speed up this up. It also makes the order of that packages are developed in not matter anymore since all of the developed packages are considered all at once.
title: Use a single Pkg.develop for CI
